en.headline: 1 commit, 1 issue comment, 1 discussion started, 3 automated commits
en.summary: On 2026-10-18, the user made **1 own commit** in `sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox`, adding documentation for the `opencode-provider` category covering catalog three-tier sources, credential ownership, endpoints, and OpenChamber jurisdiction. There were also **3 automated commits** by `github-actions[bot]` in `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`. The user commented on issue #4939 in `openchamber/openchamber` regarding text selection inside `openchamber_render` pages not opening the comment menu. They also started a new discussion #5114 in the same repo proposing to split the rendered-page selection-menu fix into a frame-to-host selection bridge approach. A reply was received on issue #4899 from `yulia-ivashko` discussing browser capture resolution at different display scaling levels. No pull requests, reviews, or releases were recorded for the day.

zh.headline: 1 次提交、1 条 issue 评论、1 个讨论、3 次自动提交
zh.summary: 2026-10-18，用户在 `sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox` 中提交了 **1 次本人提交**，为 `opencode-provider` 类别新增文档，涵盖 catalog 三层来源、凭据归属、端点与 OpenChamber 管辖。此外，`sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` 中有 **3 次由 `github-actions[bot]` 自动提交**。用户在 `openchamber/openchamber` 的 issue #4939 上留言，讨论 `openchamber_render` 页面内文本选择无法打开评论菜单的问题。用户还在同一仓库发起了新讨论 #5114，提议将渲染页面选择菜单修复拆分为 frame 到 host 的选择桥接方案。issue #4899 收到来自 `yulia-ivashko` 的回复，讨论不同显示缩放级别下的浏览器截图分辨率问题。当日无 pull request、review 或 release 记录。
